remarks: Prepare to be wowed with this beautiful and bright 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom unit filled with character and light and offers the space, layout and features for how we live today. Vaulted ceilings and abundant windows ensuring loads of sun will captivate you. The kitchen includes granite countertops, stainless appliances, gas cooking and will delight the serious home chef. The open concept main living area with gas fireplace leads to a private balcony overlooking the beautiful landscaping along Richards Avenue. The primary bedroom has a large, walk-in closet and a sumptuous spa-like bath The second bedroom is located away from the primary bedroom with a hall bathroom. Need to work from home? The additional loft on the second level offers a perfect, versatile space for an office, studio or additional sleeping. The large walk-in closet in the loft area offers an abundance of multi-functional storage space. Washer/dryer in unit and gated underground garage parking with an assigned space adds to the perfection. And plenty of additional parking in the rear lot. Amenities of StoneWood include: landscaped grounds, walking path, grassy picnic area with grill, modern front lobby, and exercise room. Located on the Norwalk/Darien border, this condo is conveniently located near numerous shops, restaurants and so much more. Make your home ownership dreams a reality. Just unpack and move right in!
